summary:
Implemented the feature by editing files only; no tests were run and nothing was committed, as requested. Changes: (1) rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__ after __rich_console__, an iterative depth-first walk with an explicit stack and level counter that returns Measurement(min, max) with 4-cell indent per level; imported Measurement from .measure. (2) rich/align.py: added Align.__repr__ returning Align(<renderable repr>, <align repr>), and a VerticalCenter(JupyterMixin) class after Align that renders lines with pad=False, pads with newline-only segments using console.size.height, and whose measurement delegates to Measurement.get. (3) CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked UNRELEASED with an Added section containing the two entries; existing STDIN line kept. (4) tests/test_align.py: imports VerticalCenter; added repr test, VerticalCenter render test (expects "

foo


" at height 6), and measurement test (3, 3). (5) tests/test_tree.py: imports Measurement; added a test expecting Measurement(11, 19) for the foo/bar/musroom risotto tree. Not implemented, by design: the two secondary reference behaviors (Align width constraint, print justify), which the spec marks as not judged. Main-guard demos, pyproject.toml, and CONTRIBUTORS.md are unchanged.
